from qiskit.exceptions import QiskitError
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.spatial.linalg import block_diag

def qc_for_J2(qreg, J1, J2):
    qc = QuantumCircuit(qreg)
    for i in range(len(qreg) - 1):
        qc.x(i).c_if(i % 2 == 0, qreg[i])
        qc.x(i + 1).c_if(i % 2 == 1, qreg[i + 1])
        qc.cx(i, i + 1)
        if i < len(qreg) - 2:
            qc.x(i + 2).c_if(J2 != 0.0, qreg[i + 2])
            qc.cx(i, i + 2)
    return qc

def energy(qc, backend):
    qc.measure(all_qubits(qc))
    job = execute(qc, backend, shots=4096)
    counts = job.result().get_counts(qc)
    return -np.log2(max(counts[list(counts.keys())[0]]) / sum(counts[list(counts.keys())[0]]))

def ground_state_energy(J1, J2, qreg):
    qc = qc_for_J2(qreg, J1, J2)
    opt_res = minimize(lambda J: energy(qc, Aer.get_backend('qasm_simulator')), 0.0, method='SLSQP', options={'maxiter': 100})
    return energy(qc.bind_parameters({'x': opt_res.x[0]}).result(return_options={'cancelled': QiskitError}), Aer.get_backend('qasm_simulator'))

def first_excited_state_energy(J1, J2, qreg):
    qc = qc_for_J2(qreg, J1, J2)
    qc_copy = qc.copy()
    qc_copy.h(all_qubits(qc_copy))
    qc_copy.barrier(range(len(qreg)))
    opt_res = minimize(lambda J: energy(qc_copy, Aer.get_backend('qasm_simulator')), 0.0, method='SLSQP', options={'maxiter': 100})
    return energy(qc.bind_parameters({'x': opt_res.x[0]}).result(return_options={'cancelled': QiskitError}), Aer.get_backend('qasm_simulator'))

    return [q for q in qc.qubits]
